There are no public showers, trash bins or utility hook-ups.'; Areas: 'Willow Point - Camping Available: Yes - Reservable Sites: No - GPS: 39.115006 -97.569038 - All Spots are Primitive Camping'; 'Wood Duck Cove - Camping Available: Yes - Reservable Sites: No - GPS: 39.1105500 -97.566942 - All camping spots are Primitive camping'; 'No camping on fishing piers'; 'Approximately 340 acres on the north and west sides of the property are designated as a refuge/special hunt area and are closed to public access except by special permit from October 1 through March 1 each year.'

Google Maps 'Ottawa State Fishing Lake' (4.5 from 274 reviews; chips 'free camping', 'travel trailer friendly'), read 2026-11-05: 'a month ago - Beautiful, FREE, camping at lakeside. Vault toilet was full of flies, but it had TP ... the sites are level. Would def stay again!'; '3 months ago - Randomly chose this lake to camp at ... had a beautiful night'; '2 months ago - We always go around to the east side. The drive through the trees is worth it.'

Esri World Imagery 39.1128,-97.5680 (330 m half), 39.1112,-97.5675 (130 m) and 39.1140,-97.5690 (150 m) with KDWP's two area GPS points, 2026-11-05: gravel shore roads run along the west and east shores 5-20 m from the water with open grass between, and an open gravel turnaround on the east-shore point at ~39.1112,-97.5675; no defined pads or parked rigs are visible, and both KDWP GPS points fall in woods 50-100 m back from those roads (Willow Point's ~110 m north-west of the west-shore road), so where the designated areas actually sit is not legible. The stored pin is on the east-shore road ~60 m from the Wood Duck Cove point.

note: KDWP state fishing lake ~9.5 mi east of Minneapolis on KS-106. Primitive camping in two designated areas, Willow Point and Wood Duck Cove, off gravel shore roads; picnic tables and fire rings, no trash service (pack it out). The north and west sides are a refuge closed Oct 1-Mar 1 except by special permit. --Claude
summary: KDWP page (live page 403; Wayback 2026-04-22) confirms free primitive camping in two designated areas (Willow Point, Wood Duck Cove), 14-day max, not reservable, three vault toilets, no hookups/showers/trash; values now manual. No site count. Recent Google reviews confirm overnight camping with trailers. Lakefront downgrade candidate -> lakeview.
